genres.name: Hypnotic Berlin Techno
genres.vibe: Dark, rolling, polymetric Berghain / Tresor warehouse techno.
genres.sounds: Kick: 909 Punch + Sub Rumble; Bass: Sub/LPF with Drive; Arp: Short FM/Pluck + Dub Delay; Pad: Vector dark drone.
genres.pedals: Keep-Sub Overdrive on bass, Filtered Dub Delay on Arp/Stabs, Gated/Dark Hall Reverb on Rim & Chords.

genres.name: Acid Techno / 303
genres.vibe: Squelching TB-303 basslines, 909 warehouse drums, euphoric rave stabs.
genres.sounds: Bass: Saw/Square Acid Mono with high resonance & fast env; Drums: Classic 909; Chords: Rave Organ/Stab.
genres.pedals: Acid Distortion / Fuzz (50% Mix + Keep Sub) on 303, Tempo Delay on Counter-Acid, Gated Reverb on Snare/Clap.

genres.name: Industrial / Hard Techno
genres.vibe: Relentless 150 BPM Schranz & industrial warehouse devastation, hoover screeches, stomping kicks.
genres.sounds: Kick: Hard Distorted 909; Lead: Detuned Saw/FM Hoover; Bass: Saturated Rumble Sub; Chords: Metallic FM Stab.
genres.pedals: Hard Clip / Fuzz Distortion + Drum Bus Crusher on Kicks & Hats, Frequency Shifter on Rim/Perc, Gated Reverb on Snare.

genres.name: Dub Techno
genres.vibe: Deep, spacious, tape-saturated Basic Channel / Maurizio dub chords and cavernous sub-bass.
genres.sounds: Chords: Warm Saw/FM with low-pass filter envelope; Bass: Pure Sine/Tri Sub; Drums: Warm 808/909 low-passed.
genres.pedals: Filtered Dub Tape Delay (dotted 8th!) + Shimmer/Hall Reverb on Chords & Sonar Lead, Tape Lo-Fi Warble on master/pads.

genres.name: Detroit Techno & Electro
genres.vibe: Broken TR-808 electro funk, Drexciya aquatic arps, and soaring soulful Detroit strings.
genres.sounds: Drums: Punchy TR-808; Bass: Snappy Analog Saw/Sub; Arp: Bright FM/Pluck; Pad: Lush Analog Strings.
genres.pedals: Stereo Chorus / Ensemble on Strings & Chords, Crunch Overdrive on 808 Snare, Ping-Pong Delay on Aquatic Arp.

genres.name: Minimal / Micro-Techno
genres.vibe: Playful, surgical Perlon / Richie Hawtin micro-grooves, beat-1-skipping bass, 7-step glitch cycles.
genres.sounds: Drums: Short dry Click/Micro kit; Bass: Snappy rubbery FM/Sine; Arp: Ultra-short Percussive Pluck.
genres.pedals: Transient Puncher (shorten sustain!) on Drums, Tempo Slicer / Micro-Delay on Bleeps, Light Chorus on Glass Pad.

genres.name: Melodic / Peak-Time Techno
genres.vibe: Widescreen Afterlife / Tale Of Us emotional peak-time techno: rolling Am-F-Dm-Em progressions & soaring leads.
genres.sounds: Bass: Tight Moog/Sub Pluck; Arp: Bright Saw Pluck with LPF sweep; Lead: Lush Detuned Supersaw/Mono Glide; Pad: Wide Strings.
genres.pedals: Shimmer Reverb + Stereo Ping-Pong Delay on Lead & Arp, Sidechain/Ducking Comp on Pad & Bass, Warm Tape Drive on Master.

genres.name: EBM / Dark Body Techno
genres.vibe: Cold, militant, sexy DAF / Gesaffelstein / Schwefelgelb dark body techno with 16th octave basslines.
genres.sounds: Bass: Aggressive Saw/Square Analog with snappy filter decay; Drums: Gated Industrial 707/Linn/909; Lead: Cold Metallic FM.
genres.pedals: Gated Reverb on Snare, Analog Overdrive / Fuzz on Octave Bass (Keep Sub ON!), Chorus/Flanger on Coldwave Stabs.

genres.name: Tribal / Hardgroove Techno
genres.vibe: Fast, funky, hip-moving Ben Sims / Funk Assault hardgroove with Afro-Latin percussion & Dorian stabs.
genres.sounds: Drums: Punchy 909 + Conga/Bongo Perc & Tuned Toms; Bass: Funky FM/Analog Pluck; Chords: Filtered Organ/House Stab.
genres.pedals: Parallel Drum Bus Compressor / Saturation on Percussion, Auto-Filter / Phaser on Chords, Short Slapback Delay on Perc.

genres.name: Psy-Techno / Rolling Trance-Tech
genres.vibe: Surgical 140 BPM rolling K-b-b-b psy-basslines, spiraling trance-tech arps, and alien laser leads.
genres.sounds: Bass: Tight Saw Pluck with snappy LPF env (zero release!); Lead: Resonant FM/Acid Squelch; Arp: Bright Saw Pluck.
genres.pedals: Stereo Ping-Pong Delay + Phaser/Flanger on Alien Lead, Granular Cloud / Shimmer on Pads, Tight Limiter/Transient Shaper on Drums.
